caption: The drawing features three distinct sketches of an oval-shaped, intricately designed object, centrally positioned within a square border on a cream-colored background. At the top center of the square is a detailed, colored rendition of the object, depicted in shades of gold and brown with swirling, looped, and angular patterns. Below this, two line drawings show the same object from different angles: the left drawing presents a frontal view with detailed curves and loops in thin pencil lines, while the right side displays a profile view that outlines the object's depth and edge contours without any color. The composition is precise and technical, with all three sketches aligned within the central square, and the remainder of the page left blank except for some faint orange spots in the corners.
title: Gold Brooch
